snippet.title: INMOST - Nintendo Switch Announcement Trailer (2020)
snippet.description:
Three playable characters within one dark, interconnecting story. Journey into the shadows with INMOST out now on Apple Arcade and coming soon to PC and Nintendo Switch.

Developed by Hidden Layer Games.

Explore a crumbling, nightmarish landscape, slice through enemies, and spring deadly traps in order to escape the evil that awaits…

Apple Arcade: http://bit.ly/INMOSTarcade
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/inmost/
Website: http://inmostgame.com/
Hidden Layer Games on Twitter: https://twitter.com/hlgteam
Chucklefish on Twitter: https://twitter.com/ChucklefishLTD
